rows.label: bf06050100_0010
rows.name:
My deepest thanks to you for agreeing to this
ceasefire, Queen Lagert, Emperor Nefer.

rows.label: bf06050100_0020
rows.name: Under the Osiris Treaty signed 350 years ago...

rows.label: bf06050100_0025
rows.name:
the Holy See was to refrain from
intervention in times of war.

rows.label: bf06050100_0030
rows.name: And yet here you are, intervening.

rows.label: bf06050100_0040
rows.name:
But I trust you have a suitable
justification, Your Holiness?

rows.label: bf06050100_0060
rows.name:
To ensure fairness in these talks,
from the Avaritia Trading Company...

rows.label: bf06050100_0070
rows.name:
Acting Chairman Nilny will attend
as a member of the arbitration committee.

rows.label: bf06050100_0080
rows.name: In addition, one person from Luxuria...

rows.label: bf06050100_0090
rows.name:
We've also asked Crown Prince Sivrit Brunet Luxuria
to attend as a committee member.

rows.label: bf06050100_0100
rows.name:
His Highness Sivrit...
Luxuria's prodigal prince...
